title: Cocoa Beach light that exploded, split into six and followed the couple
summary: Charles tells of Cocoa Beach light that exploded, split into six and followed the couple, about c. 2013 at Cocoa Beach, Florida, near Patrick Air Force Base, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Cocoa Beach, Florida, near Patrick Air Force Base

tellings.quote:
It's not one light
anymore. It's split into six.
